name: High Fiber Bread
ingredients_raw: Wheat Products (63%) [wheat Flour (atta), Wheat Fiber & Wheat Bran], Yeat, Vital Gluten, Sugar, Iodised Salt, Oats Fiber (1%), Refined Palmolein Oil, Caramel Liquid, Preservative (282), Improvers [1100(i), 1104, Xylanase, 1102 & Cellulase], Emulsifiers [472e, 471 & 481 (i)], Acidity Regulator (260) And Flour Treatment Agent (510).
